text.content:
This was a storage chamber once; now it's an overflow pen. Three or four llamas doze standing up amid scattered feed, indifferent to the goblins arguing over them. A slate chalkboard leans against the far wall, headed "WHO GOT NUZZLED TODAY (OFFICIAL)," a list of goblin names erased and rewritten so many times the slate is nearly worn through.

GM Notes

Clue: The board is this floor's whole political system laid bare. Right now Buttercup's name is circled at the top, and beneath it three goblin names are scratched out and reordered - a silent, ongoing coup fought entirely in llama attention. A goblin here will explain, at length and with complete sincerity, that the Wool-Crowned King himself started out as an ordinary drover before a llama - allegedly this same lineage - chose him.

Say if asked how the King was chosen: "He fell off one. Landed funny. Llama didn't spit at him. That's the whole test, that's always been the whole test."

Subquest - Board Politics: A goblin herder will trade a scrap of real information (a hint toward the Room 4 llama race, or a warning about the Room 8/17 wards) for help getting their name moved up the board - which just means distracting the currently-favored goblin long enough for Buttercup to wander over to someone else. Trivial, and it will absolutely start a fight among the goblins that has nothing to do with the party.
